root_cause.observation: Every measured Cargo invocation, warm builds included, carries exactly one host_compiler attempt mapped to no unit.
root_cause.cause_inferred: crates/crunch-rustc-wrapper/src/waits.rs marks any invocation passing `--crate-type proc-macro` as a proc-macro compile; Cargo's target-info probe passes every crate type while reading stdin. This matches every observation, but the probe's argv is not retained, so the identification is inferred.
root_cause.proposed_repair: Require a source path for the proc-macro HostCompiler role, so a probe that reads stdin stays a ToolProbe. Not applied in this tree; it changes the wrapper and differential executables and needs a new gate, cohort and full differential run.
